scope: RAIL-G06 train refuel and defense command availability, A5 shared verification values
changes: RailwayHud.CanExecute disables refuel without an active owner base, tank room, or coal stock; infinite-resource mode remains valid.
Defense command availability checks the mounted state, compatible unlocked building, owner-base iron, main-level upgrade cap, and available active storage power.
Buttons and programmatic callbacks use the same CanExecute result before executing the original transactional command.

RailwayNetwork defines shared cargo capacity, per-station tank amount, refuel batch, and dwell duration; TrainArmament defines installation and per-level upgrade iron. Core validation, commands, and HUD now read these values.

verification.playResult: PASS fuel stock/tank, install iron, upgrade cap, charge stored power buttons and rejected callbacks

limits: The probe used saved HUD callbacks in the live scene; physical pointer, keyboard-focus, and multiple-resolution checks remain QA-06.
The same button conditions were not retested in a standalone player build.
Numeric values remain provisional balance settings; this change shares their source without changing amounts.
